DIAGNOSIS READY: Conduct Disorder

The pattern of defiance ("You're not the boss of me") combined with reluctance to participate in gym class while enjoying free play during recess suggests a specific interest in power dynamics and avoiding direct adult authority. Given his age and the setting-specific nature of the disruption, I am considering Oppositional Defiant Disorder (ODD) versus early-onset Conduct Disorder.
